# @arki/dot

> TypeScript-first application composition framework with typed plugins, a 5-hook lifecycle (`configure` / `boot` / `start` / `stop` / `dispose`), structured manifest + diagnostics contracts, OTel-first observability, and an agent-readable CLI (`dot explain --json`, `dot doctor --json`).

`@arki/dot` is the kernel. Package adapters (`@arki/env/dot`, `@arki/kv/dot`, `@arki/db/dot`) layer on top and are versioned independently.

## Quickstart

- [Quickstart tutorial](docs/quickstart.md): Boot your first DOT app in five minutes
- [README](README.md): Overview, install, top-level concepts
- [Quickstart example](../env/docs/examples/quickstart.ts): Runnable code for the quickstart

## Plugins and lifecycle

- [Plugin authoring](docs/plugin-authoring.md): Write a `DotPlugin` — anatomy, hooks, DI, manifest contribution
- [Lifecycle](docs/lifecycle.md): The 5-hook contract — state machine, failure ordering, idempotency rules, error codes
- [Adapter authoring](docs/adapter-authoring.md): Expose a package as a DOT plugin via a `./dot` subpath export

## Diagnostics & observability

- [Diagnostics](docs/diagnostics.md): `app.manifest`, `app.diagnostics`, `dot explain`, `dot doctor`
- [Manifest contract](docs/diagnostics.md#dotappmanifest): Static graph — five-array shape
- [Diagnostics contract](docs/diagnostics.md#dotdiagnosticssnapshot): Runtime snapshot — five-array shape
- [`DiagnosticIssue` shape](docs/diagnostics.md#diagnosticissue): Stable code, severity, remediation, docsUrl
- [Observability](docs/observability.md): OTel-first traces + metrics + log correlation, `arki:dot:lifecycle` namespace, zero-cost-when-off discipline
- [In-process observers](docs/observability.md#in-process-observers): `DotLifecycleObserver` + `defineApp({ observers })` + `app.subscribe(...)` for tests / CLI / ad-hoc inspection — peer of OTel, not layered under it
- [ASCII timeline](docs/observability.md#ascii-timeline): `app.timeline()` / `renderTimeline(snapshot)` — per-phase, per-plugin duration waterfall
- [`dot doctor --observability`](docs/observability.md#verifying-sdk-registration): SDK-registration probe — emits coded warning issue (`DOT_CLI_E007`) when no OTel SDK is registered, with remediation pointing at the quick-reference

## For agents

- [Agent guide](docs/agent-guide.md): How agents inspect, generate, and verify DOT apps
- [The verification loop](docs/agent-guide.md#4-the-verification-loop): `tsc --noEmit` + `dot explain --json` + `dot doctor --json`
- [AGENTS.md convention](docs/agent-guide.md#6-agentsmd-convention): Per-app agent guidance file (emitted by `dot new`, ships in v1.1)
- [MCP is a future adapter](docs/agent-guide.md#7-mcp-is-a-future-adapter): The kernel does not depend on MCP
